"""Author separate paragraph (c)(2) private-way crossing requests."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CASE = HERE.parent.parent
ROOT = CASE.parents[1]
SOURCE = 'does not travel through an intersection or past any private way that is used to enter or exit the highway'
POLICIES = {'primary': (8.0, 'standard', None),
            'fallback1': (7.5, 'standard', None),
            'fallback2': (8.0, 'elevated_overview', None),
            'fallback3': (8.0, 'standard', 35.0)}
PRIVATE_WAY_X = 50.0
START_X = 10.0
EXIT_X = 75.0


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def put(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, allow_nan=False)+'\n')


def put_rows(path, values):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(''.join(json.dumps(v, sort_keys=True, allow_nan=False)+'\n'
                            for v in values))


def road(private_way):
    main = '''<road name="main highway with unmarked shoulder" length="300" id="212" junction="-1">
<type s="0" type="town"><speed max="35" unit="mph"/></type>
<planView><geometry s="0" x="0" y="0" hdg="0" length="300"><line/></geometry></planView>
<lanes><laneSection s="0"><center><lane id="0" type="none" level="false"><roadMark sOffset="0" type="solid" color="yellow" width="0.15"/></lane></center>
<right><lane id="-1" type="driving" level="false"><width sOffset="0" a="3.5" b="0" c="0" d="0"/><roadMark sOffset="0" type="solid" color="white" width="0.12"/></lane>
<lane id="-2" type="shoulder" level="false"><width sOffset="0" a="3.5" b="0" c="0" d="0"/><roadMark sOffset="0" type="none" color="white" width="0"/></lane></right></laneSection></lanes><objects/><signals/></road>'''
    spur = '''<road name="private access way entering highway" length="20" id="214" junction="-1">
<link><predecessor elementType="junction" elementId="1"/></link>
<type s="0" type="town"><speed max="10" unit="mph"/></type>
<planView><geometry s="0" x="50" y="-3.5" hdg="-1.5707963267948966" length="20"><line/></geometry></planView>
<lanes><laneSection s="0"><center><lane id="0" type="none" level="false"><roadMark sOffset="0" type="none" color="white" width="0"/></lane></center>
<right><lane id="-1" type="driving" level="false"><link><predecessor id="-1"/></link><width sOffset="0" a="3.5" b="0" c="0" d="0"/><roadMark sOffset="0" type="none" color="white" width="0"/></lane></right></laneSection></lanes><objects/><signals/></road>
<junction name="private way connection" id="1"><connection id="0" incomingRoad="212" connectingRoad="214" contactPoint="start"><laneLink from="-1" to="-1"/></connection></junction>'''
    return ('<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n'
            '<OpenDRIVE><header revMajor="1" revMinor="4" name="C146314 paragraph c2 private way" version="1.00" date="2026-11-08" north="3.5" south="-24" east="300" west="0" vendor="worker"/>\n'
            + main + ('\n'+spur if private_way else '') + '</OpenDRIVE>\n')


def build():
    plan = json.loads((CASE/'case-plan.json').read_text())
    if SOURCE not in plan['source_law']['text']:
        raise ValueError('paragraph (c)(2) frozen source differs')
    assignment = ROOT/'inputs'/CASE.name/'assignment.json'
    entries = []
    roads = {}
    for witness, private_way in (('exception_3_1', True), ('exception_3_2', False)):
        road_path = HERE/'roads'/(witness+'.xodr')
        road_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        road_path.write_text(road(private_way))
        roads[witness] = sha(road_path)
        for candidate, (speed, camera, stop) in POLICIES.items():
            target = HERE/'drafts'/witness/candidate
            case_id = CASE.name+'__'+witness
            values = []
            for i in range(240):
                t = (i+1)/20
                x = min(stop or 300, 5+speed*t)
                blend = max(0, min(1, (x-(START_X-3.8))/5,
                                   (EXIT_X+3.8-x)/5))
                values.append({'frame': i, 'time_s': t,
                    'source_kind': 'authored_native_request',
                    'source_branch': 'NRS 484B.210(1)(c)(2)',
                    'case_id': case_id, 'candidate_id': candidate,
                    'road_id': 212, 'ego_x_m': round(x, 6),
                    'ego_y_m': round(-1.75-3.5*blend, 6),
                    'lead_x_m': round(30+4*t, 6), 'lead_y_m': -1.75,
                    'unmarked_segment_start_x_m': START_X,
                    'unmarked_segment_end_x_m': EXIT_X,
                    'private_way_x_m': PRIVATE_WAY_X,
                    'private_way_requested': private_way,
                    'requested_c2_no_private_way_passed': not private_way,
                    'requested_c1_over_200ft': EXIT_X-START_X > 60.96,
                    'actual_private_way_passed_observed': False,
                    'actual_unmarked_distance_observed': False,
                    'actual_right_pass_observed': False,
                    'pavement_unobstructed_verified': False,
                    'no_parked_vehicles_verified': False,
                    'legal_verdict': None})
            track = target/'requested-tracks.jsonl'
            put_rows(track, values)
            cfg = {'format': 'c146314-paragraph-c2-request-v1',
                'assignment_id': CASE.name, 'case_id': case_id,
                'candidate_id': candidate,
                'source_branch': 'NRS 484B.210(1)(c)(2)',
                'assignment_sha256': sha(assignment),
                'case_plan_sha256': sha(CASE/'case-plan.json'),
                'road_sha256': sha(road_path),
                'tracks_sha256': sha(track),
                'rate_hz': 20, 'frames': 240,
                'requested_ego_speed_mps': speed,
                'camera_policy': camera, 'stop_x_m': stop,
                'unmarked_segment_start_x_m': START_X,
                'unmarked_segment_end_x_m': EXIT_X,
                'private_way_x_m': PRIVATE_WAY_X,
                'private_way_requested': private_way,
                'requested_c2_no_private_way_passed': not private_way,
                'requested_c1_over_200ft': True,
                'actual_private_way_passed_observed': False,
                'actual_unmarked_distance_observed': False,
                'actual_right_pass_observed': False,
                'original_native_observed': False,
                'status': 'unselected_native_request'}
            put(target/'config.json', cfg)
            entries.append({'case_id': case_id, 'candidate_id': candidate,
                'config_sha256': sha(target/'config.json'),
                'tracks_sha256': sha(track),
                'road_sha256': sha(road_path),
                'status': 'unselected_native_request'})
    manifest = {'format': 'c146314-paragraph-c2-construction-v1',
        'assignment_id': CASE.name, 'assignment_sha256': sha(assignment),
        'case_plan_sha256': sha(CASE/'case-plan.json'),
        'road_sha256_by_witness': roads,
        'capture_sha256': sha(HERE/'capture.py'),
        'measurement_contract_sha256': sha(HERE/'measurement-contract.json'),
        'entries': entries, 'original_native_observed': False,
        'delivery_ready': False}
    put(HERE/'manifest.json', manifest)
    return manifest


if __name__ == '__main__':
    print(json.dumps({'requests': len(build()['entries'])}))

"""Preflight copied paragraph (c)(2) private-way requests without legal claims."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

from build import SOURCE, START_X, EXIT_X, PRIVATE_WAY_X, POLICIES


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def read(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def rows(path):
    return [json.loads(s) for s in Path(path).read_text().splitlines()]


def require(ok, message):
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(message)


def check(bundle):
    bundle = Path(bundle)
    cfg = read(bundle/'config.json')
    plan = read(bundle/'case-plan.json')
    assignment = read(bundle/'assignment-source.json')
    source = plan['source_law']['text']
    require(source == assignment['law_record']['text'] and
            hashlib.sha256(source.encode()).hexdigest() ==
            '525f777bf701d9e420e3541071bc6b10de85f747a53fb044431e00826bfee06a' and
            SOURCE in source and 'not marked as a traffic lane; or (2)' in source,
            'frozen disjunctive paragraph (c) source')
    witness = cfg['case_id'].split('__')[-1]
    candidate = cfg['candidate_id']
    require(witness in ('exception_3_1', 'exception_3_2') and
            candidate in POLICIES, 'c2 witness/candidate')
    private_way = witness == 'exception_3_1'
    speed, camera, stop = POLICIES[candidate]
    road = ET.parse(bundle/'unmarked-pass.xodr').getroot()
    roads = road.findall('./road')
    main = next((x for x in roads if x.attrib.get('id') == '212'), None)
    spur = next((x for x in roads if x.attrib.get('id') == '214'), None)
    main_geometry = main.find('./planView/geometry') if main is not None else None
    require(main is not None and len(roads) == (2 if private_way else 1) and
            (spur is not None) == private_way and
            main_geometry is not None and
            all(math.isclose(float(main_geometry.attrib[k]), v) for k, v in
                (('x', 0), ('y', 0), ('hdg', 0), ('length', 300))) and
            [(int(x.attrib['id']), x.attrib['type']) for x in
             main.findall('./lanes/laneSection/right/lane')] ==
                [(-1, 'driving'), (-2, 'shoulder')] and
            main.find('./lanes/laneSection/right/lane[@id="-2"]/roadMark').attrib['type'] == 'none',
            'authored unmarked highway and private-way road count')
    if private_way:
        geometry = spur.find('./planView/geometry')
        junction = road.find('./junction')
        connection = junction.find('./connection') if junction is not None else None
        require(geometry is not None and
                math.isclose(float(geometry.attrib['x']), PRIVATE_WAY_X) and
                math.isclose(float(geometry.attrib['y']), -3.5) and
                math.isclose(float(geometry.attrib['hdg']), -math.pi/2) and
                connection is not None and
                connection.attrib['incomingRoad'] == '212' and
                connection.attrib['connectingRoad'] == '214' and
                connection.find('./laneLink').attrib == {'from': '-1', 'to': '-1'},
                'private-way spur and junction topology')
    else:
        require(road.find('./junction') is None, 'unexpected private way')
    track = rows(bundle/'requested-tracks.jsonl')
    require(cfg['format'] == 'c146314-paragraph-c2-request-v1' and
            cfg['assignment_sha256'] == sha(bundle/'assignment-source.json') and
            cfg['case_plan_sha256'] == sha(bundle/'case-plan.json') and
            cfg['road_sha256'] == sha(bundle/'unmarked-pass.xodr') and
            cfg['tracks_sha256'] == sha(bundle/'requested-tracks.jsonl') and
            cfg['source_branch'] == 'NRS 484B.210(1)(c)(2)' and
            cfg['private_way_requested'] is private_way and
            cfg['requested_c2_no_private_way_passed'] is (not private_way) and
            cfg['requested_c1_over_200ft'] is True and
            cfg['requested_ego_speed_mps'] == speed and
            cfg['camera_policy'] == camera and cfg['stop_x_m'] == stop and
            cfg['unmarked_segment_start_x_m'] == START_X and
            cfg['unmarked_segment_end_x_m'] == EXIT_X and
            cfg['private_way_x_m'] == PRIVATE_WAY_X and
            cfg['rate_hz'] == 20 and cfg['frames'] == len(track) == 240 and
            cfg['status'] == 'unselected_native_request' and
            all(cfg[k] is False for k in
                ('actual_private_way_passed_observed',
                 'actual_unmarked_distance_observed',
                 'actual_right_pass_observed', 'original_native_observed')),
            'source-bound c2 candidate')
    pass_frames = spur_zone_frames = 0
    for i, row in enumerate(track):
        t = (i+1)/20
        x = min(stop or 300, 5+speed*t)
        blend = max(0, min(1, (x-(START_X-3.8))/5,
                           (EXIT_X+3.8-x)/5))
        require(row['frame'] == i and row['time_s'] == t and
                row['source_kind'] == 'authored_native_request' and
                row['source_branch'] == cfg['source_branch'] and
                row['case_id'] == cfg['case_id'] and
                row['candidate_id'] == candidate and row['road_id'] == 212 and
                math.isclose(row['ego_x_m'], x, abs_tol=1e-6) and
                math.isclose(row['ego_y_m'], -1.75-3.5*blend, abs_tol=1e-6) and
                math.isclose(row['lead_x_m'], 30+4*t, abs_tol=1e-6) and
                row['lead_y_m'] == -1.75 and
                row['private_way_x_m'] == PRIVATE_WAY_X and
                row['private_way_requested'] is private_way and
                row['requested_c2_no_private_way_passed'] is (not private_way) and
                row['requested_c1_over_200ft'] is True and
                all(row[k] is False for k in
                    ('actual_private_way_passed_observed',
                     'actual_unmarked_distance_observed',
                     'actual_right_pass_observed',
                     'pavement_unobstructed_verified',
                     'no_parked_vehicles_verified')) and
                row['legal_verdict'] is None,
                f'authored private-way frame {i}')
        pass_frames += int(x > row['lead_x_m'] and blend >= .99)
        spur_zone_frames += int(abs(x-PRIVATE_WAY_X) <= 2 and blend >= .99)
    require((pass_frames == 0) == (stop is not None) and
            (spur_zone_frames == 0) == (stop is not None),
            'pass/spur-zone request split')
    return {'case_id': cfg['case_id'], 'candidate_id': candidate,
            'private_way_requested': private_way,
            'requested_c2_no_private_way_passed': not private_way,
            'requested_c1_over_200ft': True,
            'requested_right_ahead_frames': pass_frames,
            'requested_spur_zone_frames': spur_zone_frames,
            'actual_private_way_passed_observed': False,
            'original_native_observed': False, 'delivery_ready': False}


if __name__ == '__main__':
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    p.add_argument('--bundle', type=Path, required=True)
    print(json.dumps(check(p.parse_args().bundle)))

"""Unaccepted CARLA attempt for the C146314 paragraph (c)(2) private-way request."""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path
import queue
import subprocess
import sys
import traceback

import check


def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()


def repository():
    for parent in (Path(__file__).resolve().parent,*Path(__file__).resolve().parents):
        if (parent/'batch.json').is_file() and (parent/'runtime').is_dir():
            return parent
    raise ValueError('Pinned runtime repository unavailable')


def write_new(path,value):
    with Path(path).open('x') as stream:
        json.dump(value,stream,indent=2,allow_nan=False)
        stream.write('\n')


def pose(actor):
    transform=actor.get_transform();velocity=actor.get_velocity()
    body=actor.bounding_box.get_world_vertices(transform)
    return {'actor_id':actor.id,'blueprint':actor.type_id,
        'center_native_xyz_m':[transform.location.x,transform.location.y,
                               transform.location.z],
        'yaw_deg':transform.rotation.yaw,
        'velocity_native_xyz_mps':[velocity.x,velocity.y,velocity.z],
        'speed_mps':math.sqrt(velocity.x**2+velocity.y**2+velocity.z**2),
        'body_native_xyz_m':[[p.x,p.y,p.z] for p in body]}


def steer_to(carla,actor,target_x,target_y,target_speed):
    transform=actor.get_transform();velocity=actor.get_velocity()
    speed=math.sqrt(velocity.x**2+velocity.y**2+velocity.z**2)
    if target_speed<=.05:
        return carla.VehicleControl(steer=0,throttle=0,
                                    brake=max(.5,min(1,speed)))
    angle=math.atan2(target_y-transform.location.y,
                     target_x-transform.location.x)
    error=math.atan2(math.sin(angle-math.radians(transform.rotation.yaw)),
                     math.cos(angle-math.radians(transform.rotation.yaw)))
    return carla.VehicleControl(steer=max(-.65,min(.65,1.4*error)),
        throttle=max(0,min(1,.2+.24*(target_speed-speed))),
        brake=max(0,min(1,.35*(speed-target_speed))))


def execute(bundle,output,host,port):
    bundle=Path(bundle).resolve();output=Path(output).resolve()
    checked=check.check(bundle)
    cfg=json.loads((bundle/'config.json').read_text())
    requests=[json.loads(x) for x in
              (bundle/'requested-tracks.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
    root=repository()
    sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'runtime/pipeline/scenario_pipeline'))
    sys.path.insert(0,str(root/'runtime/pipeline/python'))
    import carla
    import numpy as np
    from pipeline_capture import PipelineCapture
    from worker_exchange.world_restore import snapshot,restore

    client=carla.Client(host,int(port));client.set_timeout(180)
    old=client.get_world();saved=snapshot(client)
    if old.get_settings().synchronous_mode or any(
        actor.type_id.startswith(('vehicle.','walker.','sensor.'))
        for actor in old.get_actors()):
        raise RuntimeError('Exclusive idle asynchronous CARLA world required')
    output.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    if any((output/name).exists() for name in
           ('native-raw-actors.jsonl','video_frames.jsonl',
            'native-capture-report.json')):
        raise ValueError('Retain prior C146314 attempt; choose fresh output')
    owned=[];videos={};logs={};camera_queues={}
    pipeline=None;changed=False;frames=0;restored=None;error=None
    lanes_verified=False;private_way_verified=False
    try:
        world=client.generate_opendrive_world(
            (bundle/'unmarked-pass.xodr').read_text(),
            carla.OpendriveGenerationParameters(vertex_distance=.25,
                max_road_length=50,wall_height=0,additional_width=0,
                smooth_junctions=False,enable_mesh_visibility=True,
                enable_pedestrian_navigation=False))
        changed=True
        settings=world.get_settings();settings.synchronous_mode=True
        settings.fixed_delta_seconds=.05;settings.substepping=True
        settings.max_substep_delta_time=.01;settings.max_substeps=10
        world.apply_settings(settings)
        world.set_weather(carla.WeatherParameters.ClearNoon)
        mapping=world.get_map()
        lanes={}
        for lane,y in ((-2,-5.25),(-1,-1.75)):
            wp=mapping.get_waypoint(carla.Location(x=60,y=y,z=1),
                project_to_road=False,lane_type=carla.LaneType.Any)
            lanes[str(lane)]=None if wp is None else {
                'road_id':wp.road_id,'lane_id':wp.lane_id}
            if wp is None or wp.road_id!=212 or wp.lane_id!=lane:
                raise RuntimeError('Generated Native right-pass lanes differ')
        lanes_verified=True
        spur_wp=mapping.get_waypoint(carla.Location(x=48.25,y=-9,z=1),
            project_to_road=False,lane_type=carla.LaneType.Any)
        spur_readback=None if spur_wp is None else {
            'road_id':spur_wp.road_id,'lane_id':spur_wp.lane_id}
        private_way_verified=(spur_wp is not None and spur_wp.road_id==214)
        if private_way_verified != cfg['private_way_requested']:
            raise RuntimeError('Generated Native private-way spur differs')
        library=world.get_blueprint_library()
        vehicle_bp=library.find('vehicle.tesla.model3')
        vehicle_bp.set_attribute('role_name','c146314_ego')
        first=requests[0]
        ego=world.try_spawn_actor(vehicle_bp,carla.Transform(
            carla.Location(x=first['ego_x_m'],y=first['ego_y_m'],z=1.5),
            carla.Rotation(yaw=0)))
        if ego is None:raise RuntimeError('C146314 ego spawn failed')
        owned.append(ego)
        lead_bp=library.find('vehicle.tesla.model3')
        lead_bp.set_attribute('role_name','c146314_lead')
        lead=world.try_spawn_actor(lead_bp,carla.Transform(
            carla.Location(x=first['lead_x_m'],y=-1.75,z=1.5),
            carla.Rotation(yaw=0)))
        if lead is None:raise RuntimeError('C146314 lead spawn failed')
        owned.append(lead)
        lead_signal=bool(cfg.get('lead_left_signal_requested',False))
        lead.set_light_state(carla.VehicleLightState.LeftBlinker if lead_signal
                             else carla.VehicleLightState(0))
        for _ in range(20):world.tick()
        write_new(output/'native-map-readback.json',{
            'source_kind':'original_native','road_sha256':sha(bundle/'unmarked-pass.xodr'),
            'native_map_sha256':hashlib.sha256(
                mapping.to_opendrive().encode()).hexdigest(),
            'driving_lane_readback':lanes,'ego_actor_id':ego.id,
            'lead_actor_id':lead.id,
            'authored_shoulder_lane_readback':True,
            'private_way_road_readback':spur_readback,
            'private_way_verified':private_way_verified,
            'pavement_condition_verified':False,
            'legal_verdict':None})
        cameras=(('overview',1280,720,85,(60,-18,36)),
                 ('forward',1280,720,90,(1,0,1.5)))
        for name,width,height,fov,location in cameras:
            bp=library.find('sensor.camera.rgb')
            for key,value in (('image_size_x',width),('image_size_y',height),
                              ('fov',fov),('sensor_tick',0)):
                bp.set_attribute(key,str(value))
            transform=(carla.Transform(carla.Location(*location),
                carla.Rotation(pitch=-55)) if name=='overview'
                else carla.Transform(carla.Location(*location)))
            sensor=world.spawn_actor(bp,transform,
                attach_to=None if name=='overview' else ego)
            owned.append(sensor);camera_queues[name]=queue.Queue()
            logs[name]=(output/(name+'.encoder.log')).open('x')
            videos[name]=subprocess.Popen(['ffmpeg','-nostdin','-hide_banner',
                '-loglevel','error','-n','-f','rawvideo','-pix_fmt','rgb24',
                '-s',f'{width}x{height}','-r','20','-i','pipe:0','-an',
                '-c:v','ffv1','-level','1',str(output/(name+'.mkv'))],
                stdin=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=logs[name])
            sensor.listen(camera_queues[name].put)
        pipeline=PipelineCapture(client,ego,output,cfg['case_id'],
            visibility=False,required_observations=[])
        start=world.get_snapshot().timestamp.elapsed_seconds
        with (output/'native-raw-actors.jsonl').open('x') as observed,\
             (output/'video_frames.jsonl').open('x') as frame_map:
            for i,request in enumerate(requests):
                lookahead=requests[min(239,i+12)]
                ego.apply_control(steer_to(carla,ego,lookahead['ego_x_m'],
                    lookahead['ego_y_m'],
                    0 if cfg['stop_x_m'] is not None and
                         request['ego_x_m']>=cfg['stop_x_m']
                    else cfg['requested_ego_speed_mps']))
                lead.apply_control(steer_to(carla,lead,
                    request['lead_x_m']+3,-1.75,4))
                frame=world.tick()
                time_s=world.get_snapshot().timestamp.elapsed_seconds-start
                ewp=mapping.get_waypoint(ego.get_location(),
                    project_to_road=False,lane_type=carla.LaneType.Any)
                lwp=mapping.get_waypoint(lead.get_location(),
                    project_to_road=False,lane_type=carla.LaneType.Any)
                row={'frame':i,'native_frame':frame,'time_s':time_s,
                    'source_kind':'original_native',
                    'requested_ego_x_m':request['ego_x_m'],
                    'requested_ego_y_m':request['ego_y_m'],
                    'requested_lead_x_m':request['lead_x_m'],
                    'observed_ego_road_id':None if ewp is None else ewp.road_id,
                    'observed_ego_lane_id':None if ewp is None else ewp.lane_id,
                    'observed_lead_road_id':None if lwp is None else lwp.road_id,
                    'observed_lead_lane_id':None if lwp is None else lwp.lane_id,
                    'ego':pose(ego),'lead':pose(lead),
                    'requested_lead_left_signal':lead_signal,
                    'observed_lead_light_state':int(lead.get_light_state()),
                    'observed_lead_left_blinker':bool(
                        lead.get_light_state() & carla.VehicleLightState.LeftBlinker),
                    'authored_shoulder_lane_readback':True,
                    'private_way_road_readback':spur_readback,
                    'private_way_verified':private_way_verified,
                    'actual_private_way_passed_observed':False,
                    'pavement_condition_verified':False,
                    'legal_verdict':None}
                pipeline.capture(frame,time_s,extra={'c146314_paragraph_c1_right_pass':row})
                observed.write(json.dumps(row,allow_nan=False)+'\n')
                for name,width,height,_,_ in cameras:
                    image=camera_queues[name].get(timeout=30)
                    while image.frame<frame:
                        image=camera_queues[name].get(timeout=30)
                    if image.frame!=frame:
                        raise RuntimeError('Native camera-frame join differs')
                    rgb=np.frombuffer(image.raw_data,dtype=np.uint8).reshape(
                        height,width,4)[:,:,:3][:,:,::-1]
                    videos[name].stdin.write(rgb.tobytes())
                frame_map.write(json.dumps({'video_frame':i,
                    'native_frame':frame,'time_s':time_s},
                    allow_nan=False)+'\n')
                frames+=1
    except BaseException as exc:
        error={'type':type(exc).__name__,'message':str(exc),
               'traceback':traceback.format_exc()}
    finally:
        if pipeline is not None:
            try:pipeline.close(confirmed=error is None)
            except BaseException as exc:
                error=error or {'pipeline_close_error':str(exc)}
        for name,process in videos.items():
            try:
                process.stdin.close()
                if process.wait(timeout=180)!=0:
                    raise RuntimeError('Lossless video encoder failed: '+name)
            except BaseException as exc:
                error=error or {'video_encoder_error':str(exc)}
            logs[name].close()
        for actor in reversed(owned):
            try:
                if actor.type_id.startswith('sensor.') and actor.is_listening:
                    actor.stop()
                actor.destroy()
            except BaseException as exc:
                error=error or {'cleanup_error':str(exc)}
        if changed:
            try:restored=restore(client,saved)
            except BaseException as exc:
                error=error or {'restore_error':str(exc)}
        write_new(output/'native-capture-report.json',{
            'case_id':checked['case_id'],'candidate_id':checked['candidate_id'],
            'config_sha256':sha(bundle/'config.json'),
            'requested_frames':240,'observed_frames':frames,
            'restoration':restored,'error':error,'accepted':False,
            'authored_shoulder_lane_readback':lanes_verified,
            'private_way_verified':private_way_verified,
            'pavement_condition_verified':False,
            'legal_verdict':None,'delivery_ready':False})
    if error:
        raise RuntimeError('C146314 Native attempt failed; see capture report')

import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from check import check

class PrivateWayC2(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_copied_statute_and_spur(self):
        result=check(Path.cwd())
        self.assertEqual(result['private_way_requested'],
                         result['case_id'].endswith('__exception_3_1'))
        self.assertTrue(result['requested_c1_over_200ft'])
        self.assertFalse(result['actual_private_way_passed_observed'])
        self.assertFalse(result['delivery_ready'])

    def test_pass_or_stop_request(self):
        result=check(Path.cwd())
        if result['candidate_id']=='fallback3':
            self.assertEqual(result['requested_right_ahead_frames'],0)
            self.assertEqual(result['requested_spur_zone_frames'],0)
        else:
            self.assertGreater(result['requested_right_ahead_frames'],0)
            self.assertGreater(result['requested_spur_zone_frames'],0)
